patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I wanted to help make pancakes and I touched the hot pan. It's all red and puffy and it STINGS.
clinical.presentationShort: 4yo F ? touched a hot pan; red, blistered area on right palm covering about 1% TBSA, brisk capillary refill, moving hand.
clinical.presentationLong: 4-year-old female who touched a hot pan, with a small superficial partial-thickness burn on the right palm covering about 1% of body surface area. Small blisters are present; sensation, circulation, and movement are intact.

diagnosis.primary: Superficial partial-thickness burn, right palm (~1% TBSA)
diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → cool, clean, non-adherent dressing, analgesia, burn precautions; discharge.
diagnosis.why: Small superficial hand burn — cool, dress, pain control, watch for infection. Palms heal well.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 4-year-old girl in a t-shirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting, holding her right hand up and protecting it. Expression: teary but calming down.
